vibe: premium minimal, monochrome + one accent per scene, kinetic type, 3D motion
notes: Style source: references/yonomi-style/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md (read before every edit)
Open with yo-open (blur-to-sharp + slow push); hook uses yonomi-stack captions, rest yonomi-word
Change the visual state every 1.5-2 s; ~60% of runtime is full-screen graphics/b-roll replacing the speaker
Transitions: yo-blur-cut between talking head and b-roll; whoosh-fast slam/whip into graphic panels; hard cuts back to the speaker
Punchline beats: yo-flash-black / yo-flash-white alternating one word per cut (0.25-0.45 s each)
Graphic panels: yo-panel (black square on grid wall) -> yo-swoosh (lime arc); b-roll titles: yo-glow-title, yo-script-title
Captions hidden whenever a full-screen graphic carries the words
Sound: low music bed ducked under VO, subtle whooshes on big moves only, no caption pops (auto_sfx false)
